technology_name: Coconut Sap Chiller for Hygienic and Unfermented Neera/Kalparasa Collection
technology_type:
Post-Harvest Technology,
Food Processing Equipment,
Agricultural Machinery & Equipment
description: The Coconut Sap Chiller is a portable device designed for the collection of hygienic and unfermented coconut sap (Kalparasa®/Neera) from the coconut spadix. As per the demand of stakeholders, molds required for the large-scale production of the Coconut Sap Chiller have been designed and fabricated.
applications:
Coconut farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and coconut producer societies
Neera/Kalparasa production and processing units
Coconut-based food and beverage manufacturers
Agri-entrepreneurs and value-added coconut product startups
Coconut development agencies and plantation sector enterprises
